title: A congressman on the progress of reverse engineering programs

tellings.quote: Yeah, I do. I just don't think they can They're going to scrap it, cuz if they did, we wouldn't we would own the skies if they had it.

plain: Asked whether secret programs to reverse engineer craft, meaning taking them apart to learn how to build them, are getting anywhere, an unnamed congressman seems to say he believes the programs exist but doubts they have worked. "If they had it," he says, "we would own the skies." His words are played in Michels's documentary episode about a scientist named Townsend Brown.
